exempt.RemoteAudit.ProtocolMain: the remote-audit-protocol executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.Protocol.main of RemoteAudit.Protocol.protocol, audited under RemoteAudit.Protocol and CoreProtocol
exempt.RemoteAudit.DifftestMain: the remote-audit-difftest executable's entry point, one line; it serves RemoteAudit.Difftest.table, audited under RemoteAudit.Difftest, through the difftest server's line protocol: a test and not a proof
exempt.RemoteAudit.VerifierMain: the remote-audit-verifier executable's entry point, one line; it runs RemoteAudit.Verifier.serve, audited under RemoteAudit.Verifier

RemoteAudit.why: the verifier is code: Lean core, C-Flock's hashes, bytes and hm96, core's randomness, and the core protocol interface its session is a component through (RemoteAudit.Protocol); no Mathlib and nothing of Security. The difftest's table (RemoteAudit.Difftest) also imports the difftest server
